summary: Sets out the IESG's policy on character sets and languages in Internet protocols, to guide standardization work in the IETF. Among its requirements is support for UTF-8. It is a best current practice.

eli5.summary: It is a rule that says Internet protocols should work with writing from all the world's languages, not just English.

questions: what is the ietf policy on character sets
do ietf protocols have to support utf-8
